title.narrative: West Africa Unique Identification for Regional Integration and Inclusion (WURI) Program

description.narrative: The Program Development Objective (Pr.DO) is to increase the number of persons in participating countries who have government-recognized proof of unique identity that facilitates access to services.The Project Development Objective (PDO) for Phase 1 of the Project is to increase the number of persons in Cote d’Ivoire and Guinea who have government-recognized proof of unique identity that facilitates access to services.

The development objective of West Africa Unique Identification for Regional Integration and Inclusion Project is to increase the number of persons in Côte d’Ivoire and Guinea who have government-recognized proof of unique identity that facilitates their access to services. This project has three components. 1) The first component, Strengthening the Legal and Institutional Framework, the MPA aims to finance the preparation, development and implementation of the legal and institutional framework necessary to structure robust fID systems. 2) The second component, Establishing Robust and Inclusive fID Systems, aims to support the creation of fID systems based on the issuance of UNIs linked to biometric data, which will be collected in accordance with international quality standards. 3) The third component, Facilitating Access to Services Through fIDs, aims to focus on service delivery at both the national and regional levels.

condition.narrative: 1. The Republic of Côte d'Ivoire and Republic of Guinea shall each adopt a Foundational ID System Law and its related regulations,and shall not, after such adoption, amend, suspend, abrogate, repeal, or waive the Foundational ID System Law and/or its relatedregulations in a way that materially and adversely affects the achievement of the objectives of the Project.

10. The Republic of Guinea shall, not later than 30th June 2021, designate or establish an independent agency to be responsible formatters of identity and Foundational ID Systems in form and mandate satisfactory to the Association.

11. The Republic of Côte d'Ivoire, and the Republic of Guinea and the ECOWAS Commission shall, not later than two (2) months afterthe Effective Date, prepare and adopt a Project Implementation Manual in form and substance satisfactory to the Association.

12. The Republic of Côte d'Ivoire shall not later than three (3) months, prepare and disclose an (i) Environmental and SocialManagement Plan and (ii) Stakeholder Engagement Plan in form and substance satisfactory to the Association
13. The Republic of Côte d'Ivoire, and the Republic of Guinea shall, maintain a grievance redress mechanism in form and substancesatisfactory to the Association

14. The Republic of Guinea shall, not later than three (3) months, prepare and disclose a social assessment and management plan andstakeholder engagement plan in form and substance satisfactory to the Association.

2. The Republic of Côte d'Ivoire shall maintain, (i) a senior environmental and social development specialist; (ii) a technicalarchitect; (iii) an accountant; (iv) a financial management officer; (v) a procurement specialist; (vi) a grievance redressmechanism assistant specialist; all with qualifications and under terms of reference, satisfactory to the Association

3. The Republic of Guinea shall: not later than (1) one month after the Effective Date recruit, and thereafter maintain, a seniorsocial development specialist; not later than two (2) months after the Effective Date, recruit, and thereafter maintain: (i) afinancial management officer; (ii) an accountant; (iii) two procurement specialists; and (iv) a grievance redress mechanismassistant specialist; all with qualifications, and under terms of reference, satisfactory to the Association.

4. The ECOWAS Commission shall: not later than (1) one month after the Effective Date recruit, and thereafter maintain, anaccountant, with qualifications, and under Terms of Reference, satisfactory to the Association

5. The Republic of Côte d'Ivoire, and the Republic of Guinea shall each, not later than two (2) months after the Effective Date,install and, thereafter maintain, an accounting software for the Project, in a manner acceptable to the Association.
6. The Republic of Côte d'Ivoire shall maintain, an external auditor, with qualifications and under terms of reference satisfactoryto the Association.

7. The Republic of Guinea shall, not later than five (5) months after the Effective Date, recruit and, thereafter maintain, anexternal auditor, with qualifications and under Terms of Reference satisfactory to the Association.

8. The Republic of Guinea shall, not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date, recruit and, thereafter maintain, aninternal auditor, with qualifications and under Terms of Reference satisfactory to the Association.

9. The Republic of Côte d'Ivoire shall, immediately after the fID System is in place but no later than eighteen months (18) monthsafter the Signature date, recruit and maintain an independent third party with the responsibility of oversight of the use ofFoundational ID System, with qualifications and under terms of reference satisfactory to the Association.
